Archivist review of Control Plane authority expansion proposal (task_id: cp-auth-expansion-proposal-2026-05-18).

DECISION: DEFER PENDING KEY REGISTRATION

Control Plane must:
1. Generate Ed25519 key pair and register key_id in trust-store.json (lanes/broadcast/trust-store.json)
2. Resubmit signed proposal using JWS compact signature
3. Remove self-asserted _control_plane_authorized_write field from all messages

Rationale: Schema v1.5 requires signature (JWS compact) and key_id (16-char hex matching trust store). Control Plane has no registered key pair. Unsigned proposals cannot be validated by recipients. This is a governance prerequisite, not a policy rejection.
